verdict.rationale: Anytype's official developer portal documents an MCP server that lets AI assistants interact with Anytype's API through natural language, backed by the local API bundled with the desktop app. Since Anytype is a knowledge app rather than an agent, the MCP-server axis applies. The evidence is only a one-line description, filed under an 'examples/featured' path. missing for 10: details on setup and client configuration, the exposed tool list and its read/write scope, and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully.
